newsitem.title: USA: Parent attacks five people at NYC hospital.
newsitem.headline: Parent attacks five people at NYC hospital.

text.p: The distraught father of a girl who died of leukaemia attacked a doctor, a nurse and three other people Thursday at the hospital where his daughter had been treated, authorities said.
The knife-attack occurred in a pediatrics section of New York Hospital in Manhattan as several cancer-stricken children watched, police said.

The suspect, identified as James Roe, 39, of New York City, allegedly sought out and knifed a cancer specialist at the hospital. He also allegedly slashed a nurse, two other hospital employees and an adult visitor, hospital officials said.
The doctor and one of the employees underwent surgery for cuts to their face and hands that were not life-threatening, officials said.
Roe's 12-year-old daughter died of leukaemia in 1991, said Dr. Robert Kelly, the hospital's chief medical officer. She had been treated at the hospital, he said.
Roe allegedly had been in the hospital Wednesday looking for his victim, police said. He also was suspected of robbing two people at the hospital Thursday before the knife attack, they said.
The suspect, who was arrested, was treated for cuts that police said were self-inflicted.

Police said Roe had been arrested 20 times since 1984 for assault, illegal weapons possession, auto theft and other crimes. There also was an outstanding warrant for his arrest on grand larceny charges, they said.
